name: Edward J. Penna

sections.heading: Summary
sections.html:
Recent SUNY Albany cybersecurity graduate with hands-on experience supporting end users,
troubleshooting hardware and software issues, and working with ticket-based support. Backs that
experience with a hands-on homelab portfolio spanning Windows/Active Directory administration,
Linux, Docker, monitoring, backup/DR, and security operations — all documented as reproducible
runbooks on GitHub. Strong at resolving login and system-access issues, diagnosing desktop
problems, and communicating clearly with non-technical users.

entries.title: IT Support Volunteer — Stony Brook Hospital
bullets: Provided technical support to end users by resolving login, system access, hardware, and software issues in a healthcare environment.
Worked with tickets to track issues and support technical resolution follow-up.
Diagnosed and troubleshot basic desktop and user-side technical problems while communicating clearly with non-technical staff.
Assisted users with day-to-day technical issues while maintaining a responsive, customer-focused support approach.

entries.title: Summer Consultant — Broadridge
bullets: Reviewed user access controls and supporting documentation to ensure accuracy, compliance, and proper system access.
Worked with attention to detail on documentation and process validation in a professional team setting.
Assisted with audit preparation, risk analysis, and process improvement in a structured enterprise environment.

entries.title: Sales Associate — Lowe's
bullets: Assisted customers directly while balancing accuracy, speed, and attention to detail.
Used Zebra devices for inventory checks, item lookup, restocking workflows, and organized task execution.
Helped maintain accurate item placement and product availability by locating items and verifying shelf organization.

items.desc: Windows troubleshooting, help-desk / end-user support, hardware & software diagnosis, ticket-based support, system configuration, technical documentation
Ubuntu / Linux Server administration, virtual machines (VMware, VirtualBox), Docker & Docker Compose, Nginx reverse proxy / TLS, systemd services & timers
TCP/IP, network troubleshooting, SSH & secure remote access, Active Directory (lab), Linux hardening, SIEM (Wazuh), vulnerability scanning (Nessus)
PowerShell, Bash, Python, Git & GitHub, Prometheus & Grafana, restic (backup / DR), Tailscale

entries.title: IT & Security Homelab Portfolio
entries.note: A growing set of hands-on IT, sysadmin, and SOC labs, each built and documented as a reproducible runbook with its configuration in version control.
bullets: Active Directory / Windows network lab: stood up a Windows Server domain (corp.lab), joined a client workstation, created and managed domain user accounts, and worked through logged break/fix troubleshooting drills.

Docker self-hosted stack: deployed multi-service Docker Compose environments on Ubuntu Server (Portainer, Nginx Proxy Manager with TLS, Uptime Kuma) behind a reverse proxy, with scripted named-volume backups.
Monitoring & observability: Prometheus, Grafana (dashboards-as-code), and Alertmanager with node_exporter metrics, PromQL alert rules, and alert routing.
Windows/AD administration toolkit: authored PowerShell scripts for system inventory, event-log triage, health reporting, and user on/off-boarding.
Backup & disaster recovery: 3-2-1 backups with restic, automated on a systemd schedule with retention policies and tested restore drills.

Security operations: Wazuh SIEM with custom detection rules, a Nessus vulnerability-management workflow, a Cowrie SSH honeypot with a Python log analyzer, phishing triage with a Python IOC extractor, and CIS-based Linux hardening measured with Lynis.

entries.title: AI Infrastructure & Automation
bullets: Deployed and maintained self-hosted automation tools on a Linux VPS, including setup, configuration, and ongoing troubleshooting of bot, connectivity, and network issues to keep services running reliably.
Used Tailscale for secure remote access and private networking to hosted services.
